exact_matches.title: Bootstrapping theta(p_c) = 0 from the half-space result: the two missing inputs
exact_matches.body:
PRIVATE REDUCTION, author-recorded. Barsky-Grimmett-Newman: at p_c(Z^d) the half-space N x Z^{d-1} has no infinite cluster. To conclude theta(p_c) = 0 in Z^d (open for 3 <= d <= 10) one would show that a unique infinite cluster (Burton-Keane) cannot be made of infinitely many finite half-space clusters connected through the boundary hyperplane. In d = 2 this works because the half-plane susceptibility at p_c is infinite. The reduction: theta(p_c) = 0 in Z^d follows from (i) infinite half-space susceptibility at p_c(Z^d), and (ii) a gluing lemma showing that finite half-space clusters linked across the hyperplane force an infinite half-space cluster on one side at a slightly larger parameter. Both (i) and (ii) are open for 3 <= d <= 10; (i) is a natural intermediate target because it is a statement about a single half-space cluster rather than about the full-space cluster.
Bernoulli percolation on Z^d, 3 <= d <= 10
Barsky-Grimmett-Newman half-space theorem; Burton-Keane uniqueness

exact_matches.title: Open problem: No percolation at criticality on Z^d for 3 <= d <= 10
exact_matches.body:
OPEN PROBLEM (source_says_open; current status no_resolution_found_in_documented_search; result status attempted_unsolved). Prove theta(p_c) = 0 for Bernoulli percolation on Z^d for every d >= 3; open for 3 <= d <= 10 (known for d >= 11 by Fitzner and van der Hofstad, and for d = 2). Source: Garban and Steif: Noise sensitivity of Boolean functions and percolation, lecture notes with open problems, Chapter XI Section 1, p. 136; also duminil_copin_icm_2018 Conjecture 1 p. 3 and duminil_copin_ising_potts_2017 Conjecture 1 p. 37. Status notes: Bounded search 2026-09-07: no resolution for 3 <= d <= 10 found; the d >= 11 result (Fitzner-van der Hofstad 2017) and the half-space result of Barsky-Grimmett-Newman remain the state of the art.
Posed in Garban and Steif: Noise sensitivity of Boolean functions and percolation, lecture notes with open problems
